parts.name: Linen face
parts.text: The face is 100 percent linen, stretched across the frame. It is the only part of the speaker you see, and the sound plays out through it.

parts.name: Gold inner trim
parts.text: A fine gold line where the frame meets the screen. It is the detail that makes the frame read as part of the room.

parts.name: Frame finish
parts.text: The visible edge of the frame, in Onyx, Basalt, Alabaster or Sandstone. Any linen can be paired with any finish.

parts.name: Eight speakers
parts.text: Four speakers sit in each side rail, eight in all. This is the only place on this site you will see them. In your room they stay behind the linen.

parts.name: HDF frame
parts.text: The structure is high-density fiberboard (HDF), a dense engineered wood. It carries the speakers and gives the frame its shape.

parts.name: Damping layer
parts.text: Soft material behind the speakers, there to absorb sound from the back of the frame.

parts.name: Crossover and wiring
parts.text: The wiring bay routes the audio signal to the eight speakers and divides it between them.

parts.name: Mounting brackets
parts.text: Hardware at the back that fixes the frame to the wall around your TV.
